description: 外國持卡人於六都十六縣以信用卡支付網路購物(EC)之金額及筆數 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 金融監督管理委員會銀行局. 統計自2014年起，外國卡持卡人於臺灣六都十六縣之網路商店消費的信用卡簽帳金額及筆數(資料範圍係指經聯合信用卡處理中心處理之信用卡消費交易). Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 金融監督管理委員會銀行局. Its tags are 投資理財. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-11-27 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
